props.text: Everything your notes need, nothing they don't
Write, organise and find your ideas in one calm workspace that works offline and syncs across every device you own.
Full-text search covers every notebook, tag and attachment, so the note you need appears as you type.
Changes sync instantly between your phone, tablet and laptop, and wait safely on your device when you go offline.
Notebooks and tags that stay tidy
Group notes into notebooks and label them with as many tags as you need, then filter by either in a single tap.
Markdown that stays out of the way
Type plain text with simple markup and watch headings, lists and checklists format themselves as you write.
The web clipper keeps articles, links and screenshots in your notes with one click, complete with the source.
End-to-end encryption locks every note on your device, so only you can read what you write, not even us.
